reference.source: Psychiatry topic map (Marrow e6 topic selection only; text rewritten in own words, no verbatim copy)
clinicalPearls: Thiamine before glucose in at risk drinkers
Delirium tremens at 48 to 96 hours kills untreated
Acamprosate abstinence, naltrexone heavy drinking, disulfiram aversive
Full Wernicke triad is minority: treat on suspicion
reference.pathophysiology: Chronic alcohol neuroadaptation down regulates GABA and up regulates glutamate, so cessation unleashes excitatory autonomic storm; thiamine dependent carbohydrate metabolism failure injures mammillary bodies and thalamus producing Wernicke Korsakoff lesions.
additionalDifferentials: Korsakoff amnesia versus dementia (confabulation, isolated memory)
Harmful use versus dependence (withdrawal and control)
additionalInvestigations: AUDIT score, withdrawal severity CIWA pattern monitoring
Thiamine status clinically, liver panel, MCV, GGT adjuncts
CT head when seizures focal or head injury suspected
